question: How many schedules are there in Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Twelve​.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Currently, the constitution of India has 12 schedules which were 8 originally. **
 
• The First Amendment Act added the** 9th schedule **in the constitution.
 
• The** Sixth Schedule **of the constitution is related to Provisions for the administration of Tribal Area in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram, and Ladakh.
 
• The** 35th constitutional Amendment Act** added the 10th schedule in the constitution in 1974 regarding the “associate Status” of the Sikkim.
 
• Later **36th amendment act **admitted Sikkim as state of India.
 
• A New **10th schedule** was added by the** 52nd amendment act 1985** in context with the **“Anti-Defection” Law.**
 
• The **Ninth Schedule **of the Constitution is beyond judicial review.
